newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil stocks close higher after futures setlement.
newsitem.headline: Brazil stocks close higher after futures setlement.

text.p: Brazilian shares ended 0.8 percent higher in seesaw trade after players liquidated their futures index contracts, brokers said.
The Bovespa index .BVSP of the 49 most active stocks closed at 9,566 points. Market turnover was 610.5 million reais ($575.5 million).
Analysts said the futures expiry brought no surprises as many players already had rolled over their positions for the next settlement in June.
Traders said that now market attention will be focusing on the April 22 options settlement.
They said they expect the fight between players holding short and long positions to intensify in coming sessions, increasing market volatility.
Telebras preferred, the underlying stock for the more-held options, ended up 1.19 percent at 118.90 reais.
State mining concern Vale do Rio Doce rose 1.35 percent to closed at 26.25 reais.
The power sector index, comprising the nine most liquid stocks of the electrical industry, rose 0.64 percent to 2,635 points.
